crossRefs.note: But if you don’t forgive men their trespasses, neither will your Father forgive your trespasses.

translations.web: But if you don’t forgive men their trespasses, neither will your Father forgive your trespasses.
translations.bsb: But if you do not forgive men their trespasses, neither will your Father forgive yours.
translations.kjv: But if ye forgive not men their trespasses, neither will your Father forgive your trespasses.
translations.asv: But if ye forgive not men their trespasses, neither will your Father forgive your trespasses.
